failure_paths.format: Formatting errors propagate through write! as fmt::Result; no unwrap.
failure_paths.resources: Finite input/bit size determines work and temporary storage; standard allocator and crypto-library runtime contracts apply. No process-wide memory reservation or recovery from allocator abort is claimed.
failure_paths.serde: Derived fixed-array serde rejects malformed types/lengths via serde errors; it does not admit any mathematical law.
failure_paths.undefined_ratio: Total opaque encoding, never a successful mathematical admission. The old reachable zero-denominator panic is retained in the rank-replay finding and failing trace.

formal_specification.authority: None. No theorem admission, signature, author identity, provenance authentication or mathematical collision impossibility is exported.
formal_specification.domain: Opaque content fingerprints of stored candidate data. Every BigRational representation, including denominator zero, is in the fingerprint input domain. Hash256 is arbitrary 32 bytes and is not admission or authentication.
formal_specification.framing: Every literal tag and field order is specified in hash_protocol_oracle.rs. Matrix dimensions/vector/string byte lengths use u64 little endian on this 64-bit target, degrees i32 little endian, manifest version u32 little endian. Graded kind and basis are length-prefixed, followed by a nested vector digest; chain/cochain manifests bind three dimensions and two ordered digests. Carrier binds version, d0,d1,weights, dimensions, Q and BigRational constants. Witness binds four ordered dimensions and provenance digest. Provenance binds all UTF-8 bytes after its tag.
formal_specification.scalars: For denominator != 0 encode the value-normalized numerator/positive denominator pair using length-prefixed signed little-endian BigInt bytes. For denominator == 0 encode the stored numerator and zero with the same framing, without rational arithmetic. No undefined pair becomes Q, infinity, or an admitted matrix.
formal_specification.views: as_bytes returns all 32 bytes; to_hex is 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; Display contains first and last four bytes separated by two dots. Serde transports bytes without claiming mathematical validity.

invariant_argument: The helper divides the stored-ratio domain into disjoint denominator-zero and nonzero cases before any normalization. The zero case only reads arbitrary-precision integers. The nonzero case invokes Ratio::reduced, whose sole denominator-zero panic condition is excluded. Canonical Q and all defined noncanonical ratios retain their previous value encoding.

Each hasher appends exactly the fields in its explicit wire specification. Finite slices/strings bound all loops; dimension metadata is observed without allocating matrices. Length framing and fixed-width fields disambiguate these encodings within each stated fixed tag/version. This is a preimage-format argument, not a BLAKE3 collision proof.

Hash256 slice boundaries 0..4 and 28..32 are statically within its 32-byte array. Serialization admits opaque bytes only. Public tuple construction cannot construct a rank/category/carrier certificate.

The target has usize width 64, so all usize-to-u64 lengths and dimensions are exact. Degree and version encode their declared fixed-width values without narrowing. BigInt coefficient encoding uses no fixed-width coefficient conversion.

Hasher update/finalize, BigInt byte storage, num-rational reduction on a nonzero denominator, hex, serde and allocation retain the declared safe library/runtime contracts. There is no recursion, partial index, rational arithmetic on undefined values or swallowed error in this module.
